## `computers list`

Retrieves the list of Computers with pagination (sorting and filtering). Sort by Created Date, Ascending to avoid returning duplicate entries.

```
epm-cli computers list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Computers` · Response: `ComputerListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--computer-id` | UUID |  | The Id of the Computer(Guid format), for example - 59A00329-87AC-49EC-BC2C-9B9E26F05185 |
| `--host` | string |  | The host name of the Computer, for example - Computer1 |
| `--host-type` | string | `Undefined`, `MicrosoftWindows`, `AppleMacOS`, `Linux` | The host type of the Computer, for example - MicrosoftWindows, Linux |
| `--agent-version` | string |  | The agent version of the Computer, example - 5.6.126.0 |
| `--adapter-version` | string |  | The adapter version of the Computer, example - 20.5.195.0 |
| `--package-manager-version` | string |  | The Package Manager version on the Computer, example - 20.5.195.0 |
| `--authorisation-state` | string |  | The state of the Computer, example - Authorised, Pending |
| `--last-connected-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--last-connected-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--policy-revision-status` | string |  | Policy Revision Status, example - AwaitingLatestPolicy |
| `--policy-id` | UUID |  | Policy Id, example - 59A00329-87AC-49EC-BC2C-9B9E26F05185 |
| `--policy-name` | string |  | Policy Name (Assigned Policy to Group/Endpoint), example - Policy1 |
| `--host-policy-name` | string |  | Host Policy Name (Current Policy on Endpoint), example - Policy1 |
| `--group-id` | UUID |  | Group Id, example - 59A00329-87AC-49EC-BC2C-9B9E26F05185 |
| `--group-name` | string |  | Group Name, example - Group1 |
| `--os` | string | `Windows`, `Mac` | OS Name, example - Windows |
| `--domain` | string |  | Domain Name, example - BeyondTrust |
| `--created-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--created-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--duplicate-count-min` | integer |  | Min Value of CountRange, example - 1,2,3 |
| `--duplicate-count-max` | integer |  | Max Value of CountRange, example - 1,2,3 |
| `--connection-status` | list of string |  | ConnectionStatus |
| `--days-disconnected` | integer |  | DaysDisconnected |
| `--days-since-archived` | integer |  | DaysSinceArchived |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli computers list --all -o json
```

## `computers delete`

Deletes Computers

> **Destructive:** asks for confirmation before it runs; scripts must pass `--yes`. Preview with `--dry-run` first.

```
epm-cli computers delete [flags]
```

API: `DELETE /v3/Computers`

**Request body** (JSON, `ComputersRemoveRequest`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--computer-ids` | `computerIds` | list of UUID |  | List of Computers identifiers to be removed (optional when allComputers is true, otherwise its required) |
| `--excluded-computer-ids` | `excludedComputerIds` | list of UUID |  | List of Computers identifiers to be excluded from the deletion list. excluded computers Ids will only be applicable when "allComputers" is set to false. |
| `--all-computers` | `allComputers` | switch |  | Flag for all Computers matching BT.Common.ManagementApi.Computer.ComputerFilterModel and ExcludedComputerIds should be removed |

    "host": "",

    "agentVersion": "",
    "adapterVersion": "",

      "dates": [

    "groupId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
    "groupName": "",
    "os": "Windows",
    "domain": "",

      "dates": [
        "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      ],
      "selectionMode": "Single"
    },
    "duplicateCount": {
      "min": 0,
      "max": 0
    },
    "connectionStatus": [
      ""
    ],
    "daysDisconnected": 0,
    "daysSinceArchived": 0
  },
